key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers directly from measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Equip an open 14B model with read-only SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: Evaluation uses 45,441 device records and reports SQL-enabled accuracy of 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature.
watch_item: SQL-enabled accuracy remains near 51%, so quantitative outputs still require verification against the underlying records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
